what: A real GitLab instance running this fork's compiled frontend, so the Material work can be judged from a running application rather than from source.
servedFrom: Omnibus GitLab 19.3.1 in WSL2 Ubuntu 26.04, with this fork's webpack output layered over the stock webpack directory
method: hidden Windows desktop, isolated guest Edge profile with sync and extensions disabled, exactly one CDP page target verified before capture, window resolved by explicit handle from the headless desktop listing

captures.shows: The GitLab Community Edition sign-in page served by the instance, rendered from this fork's compiled webpack bundles.

honestReading: This surface renders as stock GitLab. That is expected and consistent with the measured wiring: pages/devise/sessions/new.js imports only login.scss from material_system, so no Material surface mounts here. Of 25 design contracts and 25 written surface directories, only three mount points are rendered by any Rails view: admin, agent-memory and manage. Capturing those needs an authenticated session and is not yet done.
limitation: WSL2 terminates the distro shortly after the last command exits, which stops GitLab. A keepalive process must hold the distro open for the duration of any capture run, or the browser will get ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED against an instance that answered curl moments earlier.
